title: Boxing
description:
Sebastian Fundora vs. Ermal Hadribeaj
Sebastian Fundora (24-1-1, 16 KOs) defends his WBC super welterweight title against unbeaten mandatory challenger Ermal Hadribeaj (23-0-1, 8 KOs), from Las Vegas. Also: Brandon Figueroa defends his WBA featherweight title against Tomoki Kameda.

title: Training Day
description: A rookie police officer meets a corrupt Los Angeles narcotics detective who wants to include him in his schemes.

title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis
description:
S01 E03 — Bad Romance
NHL forward Wyatt Johnston and Howie Mandel set up NHL defenseman Lian Bichsel at a restaurant where a romantic proposal meltdown turns him into the unwitting villain.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E04 — Know Thyself
The team hunts for a serial killer who is targeting young, homeless men; Tiffany and Scola don't see eye to eye on how to handle the case.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E05 — Charlotte's Web
After a suburban woman is kidnapped from her home, the team looks into trysts on both sides of a seemingly perfect marriage; OA feels pressure from Mona to make changes in his career path.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E06 — Allegiance
The team must track down a shooter targeting detectives from the same precinct and unit while facing mounting tension from the NYPD; Tiffany finds that her NYPD roots may be influencing her view of the situation.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E06 — Double Bind
As the team works to rescue a 5-year-old kidnapping victim, Scola suspects the boy's mother isn't being forthcoming about why her son was targeted; Nina struggles to open up to Scola about matters in their relationship.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E07 — Ready or Not
Maggie returns from medical leave and helps the team investigate two homicides: a law student and a young man with possible gang ties; an inadvertent revelation from Maggie causes OA to worry that she is rushing back into the job too quickly.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E08 — Into the Fire
When a deadly truck heist arms the killers with enough ammonium nitrate to construct a massive bomb, the team discovers a link to a terrorist group Maggie is working to infiltrate.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E07 — Gone Baby Gone
After a young girl is kidnapped from her daycare, the team must help her parents navigate a debt owed to the deadly gang in their neighborhood; Maggie struggles to focus on the case when her sister returns from rehab.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E08 — Fire and Rain
A widow is shocked that her new "boyfriend" is the manipulative leader of a terrorist group planning an attack; Scola is reminded of his brother's death on 9/11; Tiffany worries about his emotional choices during the investigation.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E09 — Unfinished Business
After Rina is critically wounded while heading to work with Jubal, the team makes the chilling discovery that a vengeful Vargas orchestrated the shooting from behind bars and continues to target the rest of their team and their loved ones.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E10 — Fostered
As the team investigates a string of jewelry store robberies that culminate in a double murder, they uncover a connection to a 16-year-old boy trying to survive the foster care system.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E11 — Grief
The team searches for an abducted college coed; Jubal has a tense encounter with Rina's mother.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E12 — Under Pressure
Maggie goes undercover working in a bar to investigate an anti-government group that regularly gathers there; a single father on the periphery of the group begins to fear he's in danger of becoming collateral damage.

Paige steals the Book of Shadows to use its spells for personal gain; a grieving Piper is vulnerable to the enticements of the Furies.

A Zen master's disciple causes trouble for Paige and Phoebe after a potion mishap causes the sisters to change bodies.

title: Charmed

A hideous demon (Robert Englund) shrinks Phoebe to 5-inches tall and uses her as bait for the other two sisters.

title: Charmed
description:

Paige finds her knight in shining armor when a beloved fairytale comes true, but she must also contend with an evil incarnation of herself from a past life as a medieval enchantress.

title: Charmed
description:
S04 E07 — Brain Drain
Phoebe and Paige must prevent a deluded Piper from giving up their powers after she lands in a mental institution.

title: Charmed
description:
S04 E08 — Black As Cole
While mulling over his marriage proposal, Phoebe comes face-to-face with proof of Cole's demonic past in the shape of a vengeful widow.

title: Charmed
description:

Phoebe, Paige and Piper battle warlocks who are using muses for evil purposes; an insecure Cole loses his cool when Phoebe turns down his marriage proposal.

title: Charmed
description:
S04 E10 — A Paige From the Past
Leo takes Paige back in time so she can confront her guilt about her parents' deaths; ghosts possess Phoebe's and Cole's bodies and head to a chapel to get married.

title: Charmed
description:
S04 E11 — Trial by Magic
A premonition shows Phoebe that the defendant in a murder trial is innocent despite the wealth of evidence against him.

title: Cold Case
description:

Rush and the team reopen the 1988 murder case of a young reporter when previously unseen footage of her is found and indicates she was working on a big story.

title: Cold Case
description:
S06 E14 — The Brush Man
The team reopens the 1967 murder case of a brush salesman after his remains are found in a duck pond.

title: Cold Case
description:
S06 E15 — Witness Protection
The team looks for a missing teenager while investigating the five-month-old murder of his father, both of whom were in witness protection.

title: Cold Case
description:
S06 E16 — Jackals
A newfound photo of a murdered 17-year-old on the back of a motorcycle indicates her connection to a notorious gang and prompts the team to reopen the 1976 case.

The team tries to figure out if a homeless paranoid schizophrenic killed his former psychiatrist in 2004 before fully losing his grip on reality.

title: Cold Case
description:
S06 E19 — Libertyville
New evidence prompts the team to re-examine the 1958 murder of a newlywed Ivy League grad (Johnathon Schaech) who led the charge for developing suburban communities with affordable housing outside Philadelphia.

While preparing for their annual softball game, team members are called in to investigate the murder of a former Cuban baseball star who escaped to the United States after running afoul of his government.

Paige discovers a 10-year-old runaway is a firestarter and his parents are demon bounty hunters who are trying to teach him to use his powers for good.

title: Charmed

The lives of Leo and Cole hang in the balance as the Source siphons away all magical powers, both good and evil, after he learns he is doomed to be vanquished by the Charmed Ones.

Phoebe conjures a younger version and an older version of herself to help her decide whether she should marry Cole.

title: Charmed

A demon crashes Phoebe's wedding hoping to disrupt the proceedings and plant the seeds of discord among the sisters.

title: Charmed
description:

Paige feels out of place among her happily married older sisters and their spouses, plus she becomes convinced Cole is a demon.

Lilly and the team investigate the 2005 murder of a female cadet at a local military school.

The team reopens the case of an innocent teenage inmate, killed in a juvenile detention center; Lilly reconnects with former love Saccardo.

The team investigates the 1970 murder of a musician who kept his involvement with Philadelphia's music scene a secret from his strict preacher father; Lilly meets her teenage stepbrother.

The team investigates the 1944 murder of a woman who volunteered to fly noncombat missions for the Air Force; Lilly fixates on her nemesis.

After six decades of searching, two wrathful wraiths who fought alongside Leo during World War II track him down to exact revenge.

title: Charmed

A vampire queen (Elizabeth Gracen) orders minions to convert Paige in order to shift the balance of power before trying to unseat Cole as ruler of the Underworld.

title: Charmed
description:
S04 E19 — We're off to See the Wizard
Piper and Paige help a wizard (Armin Shimerman) stop the coronation of a new Source, unaware that Cole is the new leader of the Underworld.

title: Charmed
description:

When queen-to-be Phoebe rejoins her sisters to save an innocent, the denizens of the Underworld threaten a coup unless the witch proves her dark allegiance by killing Piper and Paige.
